cues.en: Hello, I'm Robert McKenzie.

cues.zh: 你们和我一起，来到这座精美的老图书馆
cues.en: You join me here in this fine old library

cues.zh: 在芝加哥大学的校园里。
cues.en: on the campus of the University of Chicago.

cues.zh: 我们即将看到10部影片中的第一部
cues.en: We are about to see the first of 10 films by
Milton Friedman, an economist of

cues.zh: 享誉国际的经济学家，诺贝尔奖
cues.en: international repute, winner of the

cues.zh: 得主，也是我们这个时代最具争议
cues.en: Nobel Prize, one of the most controversial

cues.zh: 和最具启发性的美国人之一。
cues.en: and stimulating Americans of our time.

cues.zh: 在接下来的几周里，随着Friedman的
cues.en: In the weeks that lie ahead as Friedman’s

cues.zh: 首个大型电视系列节目陆续播出，
cues.en: first major television series unfolds,

cues.zh: 那些将坐在这几把椅子上的
cues.en: the famous and influential men and women

cues.zh: 知名而有影响力的男士和女士们
cues.en: who’ll occupy those seats are going to

cues.zh: 将对Friedman关于我们当今所处社会的
cues.en: have a lot to say about Friedman’s view

cues.zh: 观点，以及他对我们这个时代弊病的
cues.en: of the society in which we live today,

cues.zh: 解决方案，有很多话要说。
cues.en: and his solutions for the ills of our time.

cues.zh: 因为这就是这个系列的主题：
cues.en: For that’s what the series is about:
Milton Friedman's view of the way

cues.zh: 生活方式的看法，以及我们将走向何方。
cues.en: we live now, and where we’re headed.

cues.zh: 现在，就像这里的一些人一样，
cues.en: Now like some people here

cues.zh: 你可能会对他的观点感到震惊，
cues.en: you may be appalled by his ideas,

cues.zh: 也像另一些人一样，对这些观点
cues.en: like others, extremely enthusiastic about
about them. Whichever way it goes,
I think you will be fascinated by
what Milton Friedman has to say.
(opening music)
(radio newscast of morning weather)

cues.zh: 米尔顿·弗里德曼的声音：
cues.en: Milton Friedman's voice:
Once all of this was a swamp,
covered with forest.

cues.zh: 居住在此的卡纳西印第安人
cues.en: The Canarsie Indians who lived here
traded the 22 square miles of

cues.zh: 湿漉漉的曼哈顿岛交易给了荷兰人
cues.en: soggy Manhattan Island to the Dutch

cues.zh: 换来了价值24美元的布料和小饰品。
cues.en: for $24.00 worth of cloth and trinkets.
(seagulls squawking)

cues.zh: 新来者建立了一座城市，
cues.en: The newcomers founded a city,
New Amsterdam, at the edge
an empty continent.
In the years that followed,
it proved a magnet for millions of
people from across the Atlantic,

cues.zh: 这些人被恐惧和贫困所驱使，
cues.en: people who were driven by fear and poverty,

cues.zh: 又被自由与富足的承诺
cues.en: who were attracted by the promise
of freedom and plenty.
They fanned out over the continent
and built a new nation with their

cues.zh: 和对更美好未来的憧憬
cues.en: sweat, their enterprise and their vision
of a better future.

cues.zh: 很多人有生以来第一次
cues.en: For the first time in their lives,
many were truly free to pursue
their own objectives.
That freedom released the human
energies which created the United States.
For the immigrants who were

cues.zh: 受到这座雕像欢迎的移民来说，
cues.en: welcomed by this statue,
America was truly a
land of opportunity.
(steamboat horn)

cues.zh: 他们穿着最好的衣服涌上岸，
cues.en: They poured ashore in their best clothes,
eager and expectant, carrying
what little they owned.
They were poor, but they all had
a great deal of hope.
(people walking, talking)
Once they arrived,
they found, as my parents did,

cues.zh: 生活并不轻松，而是非常艰难。
cues.en: not an easy life, but a very hard life.
But for many there were
friends and relatives to help them
get started -- to help them
make a home, get a job,

cues.zh: 在这个新国家安定下来。
cues.en: settle down in the new country.
(trolley bell and horses clip-clopping)
There were many rewards for

cues.zh: 进取心和能力带来了许多回报。
cues.en: hard work, enterprise and ability.

cues.zh: 生活艰难，但机会是真实的。
cues.en: Life was hard, but opportunity was real.

cues.zh: 过去几乎没有政府项目
cues.en: There were few government programs

cues.zh: 可以求助，也没人指望它们。
cues.en: to turn to and nobody expected them.
But also, there were
few rules and regulations.
There were no licenses,

cues.zh: 没有许可证，没有繁文缛节
cues.en: no permits, no red tape
to restrict them.

cues.zh: 事实上，他们面对的是一个自由市场，
cues.en: They found, in fact, a free market,

cues.zh: 大多数人靠它兴旺起来。
cues.en: and most of them thrived on it.

cues.zh: 许多人至今仍来到美国
cues.en: Many people still come to the United States
driven by the same pressures
and attracted by the same promise.

cues.zh: 你可以在这样的地方找到他们。
cues.en: You can find them in places like this.
It's Chinatown in New York, one of
the centers of the garment industry,
a place where hundreds of thousands
of newcomers have had their first

cues.zh: 体验到这个新国家的生活。
cues.en: taste of life in the new country.

cues.zh: 在这里生活和工作的这些人
cues.en: The people who live and work here
are like the early settlers.

cues.zh: 他们想改善自己的境遇，而且
cues.en: They want to better their lot and they are
prepared to work hard to do so.

cues.zh: 虽然我不常进这样的工厂，
cues.en: Although I haven't often been in factories

cues.zh: 但这一切对我来说都很熟悉，
cues.en: like this, it's all very familiar to me,

cues.zh: 因为这和我母亲当年工作的
cues.en: because this is exactly the same kind of
a factory that my mother worked in

cues.zh: 那时她第一次来到这个国家，
cues.en: when she came to this country
for the first time at the age of 14,
almost 90 years ago.
And if there had not been
factories like this here then at which
she could have started to work
and earned a little money
she wouldn't have been able to come.

cues.zh: 如果我存在的话，我今天
cues.en: And if I existed at all, I'd be

cues.zh: 会是俄罗斯人或匈牙利人，
cues.en: a Russian or a Hungarian
today, instead of American.

cues.zh: 当然，她没在这里待很久。
cues.en: Of course she didn't stay here a long time.
She stayed here while she learned
the language, while she developed

cues.zh: 对这个国家有了一些感觉，
cues.en: some feeling for the country,
and gradually she was able to

cues.zh: 为自己创造更好的生活。
cues.en: make a better life for herself.
Similarly, the people who are here now,

cues.zh: 他们就像我母亲一样，大多是
cues.en: they are like my mother, mostly
immigrants from a distant country.

cues.zh: 他们来这里是因为更喜欢这里
cues.en: They came here because they liked it
here better and had more opportunities.

cues.zh: 这样的地方给了他们一个机会
cues.en: A place like this gives them a chance
to get started.
They are not going to stay here
very long or forever.

cues.zh: 相反，他们和他们的孩子
cues.en: On the contrary, they and their children

cues.zh: 会为自己创造更好的生活
cues.en: will make a better life for themselves
as they take advantage of the opportunities
that a free market provides to them.

cues.zh: 讽刺的是，这个地方违反了许多
cues.en: The irony is that this place violates many of
the standards that we now regard as

cues.zh: 每个工人应有权利的标准。
cues.en: every worker's right.
It is poorly ventilated,
it is over-crowded,

cues.zh: 工人们接受的报酬低于工会标准——
cues.en: the workers accept less than union rate-
it breaks every rule in the book.
But if it were closed down,
who would benefit?
Certainly not the people here.

cues.zh: 他们的生活看起来可能很艰难，
cues.en: Their lives may seem pretty tough
compared to our own,
but that’s only because
our parents or grandparents

cues.zh: 为我们经历了那个阶段。
cues.en: went through that stage for us.

cues.zh: 我们得以从更高的起点开始。
cues.en: We’ve been able to start at a higher point.
Frank Visalli's father was 12 years old
when he arrived all alone
in the United States.
He had come from Sicily.
That was 53 years ago.
Frank is a successful dentist
with a wife and family.

cues.zh: 他们住在马萨诸塞州的列克星敦。
cues.en: They live in Lexington, Massachusetts.
(pouring wine, chatting with wife)
There is no doubt in Frank's mind
what freedom combined with opportunity

cues.zh: 对他父亲以及对他自己意味着什么，
cues.en: meant to his father and then to him,

cues.zh: 也不怀疑他的意大利祖父母会怎么想
cues.en: or what his Italian grandparents would think

cues.zh: 如果他们能看到他现在的生活。
cues.en: if they could see how he lives now.

cues.zh: 他们不会相信眼前所见，
cues.en: They would not believe what they would see,
that a person could emigrate

cues.zh: 从一个小岛来，取得如此成就
cues.en: from a small island and make such success
out of their life,

cues.zh: 因为对他们来说，他们大多与
cues.en: because to them they were mostly related
to the fields,

cues.zh: 像农民一样在田里劳作。
cues.en: working in the field as a peasant.
My father, he came over,

cues.zh: 为自己打拼出了一番事业，
cues.en: he made something for himself,

cues.zh: 然后他努力建立一个家庭结构。
cues.en: and then he tried to build a family structure.

cues.zh: 他所做的一切都是为了他的家人。
cues.en: Whatever he did was for his family.

cues.zh: 这是为了让家人过上更好的生活。
cues.en: It was for a better life for his family.
And I can always remember
him telling me that,
you know, the number one thing in life
is you should get an education
to become a professional person.
(dinner conversation, dishes clinking)
The Visalli family,
ike all of us who live
in the United States today,

cues.zh: 很大程度上要归功于自由的氛围
cues.en: owe much to the climate of freedom

cues.zh: 我们从国家缔造者那里
cues.en: we inherited from the founders
of our country,
the climate that gave full scope

cues.zh: 来自其他土地的穷人充分的空间，他们来到
cues.en: to the poor from other lands who came

cues.zh: 这里，能够为自己和子女
cues.en: here, and were able to make better
lives for themselves and their children.
But in the past 50 years,

cues.zh: 我们一直在挥霍这份遗产
cues.en: we've been squandering that inheritance
by allowing government to control
more and more of our lives,
instead of relying on ourselves.

cues.zh: 我们需要重新发现那些古老的真理
cues.en: We need to rediscover the old truths

cues.zh: 那些移民骨子里就懂的真理；
cues.en: that the immigrants knew in their bones;
what economic freedom is,
and the role it plays

cues.zh: 维护个人自由中扮演的角色。
cues.en: in preserving personal freedom.
(gong and Oriental music)

cues.zh: 这就是我来这里的原因
cues.en: That's why I came here
to the South China Sea.
It's a place where there’s

cues.zh: 几乎就像一场实验室实验
cues.en: an almost laboratory experiment
in what happens when government is limited

cues.zh: 在其应有职能之内，让人们自由
cues.en: to its proper function and leaves people free

cues.zh: 追求自身目标时会发生什么。
cues.en: to pursue their own objectives.

cues.zh: 如果你想看看自由市场
cues.en: If you want to see how the free market

cues.zh: 究竟如何运作，就该来这里：
cues.en: really works this is the place to come:
Hong Kong, a place with hardly

cues.zh: 没有任何自然资源的地方。
cues.en: any natural resources.
About the only one you can name

cues.zh: 大概就是一个优良的港口。
cues.en: is a great harbor.
Yet the absence of natural resources
hasn't prevented
rapid economic development.
Ships from all nations come here

cues.zh: 进行贸易，因为这里没有关税，
cues.en: to trade because there are no duties,
no tariffs on imports or exports.
The power of the free market
has enabled the industrious people
of Hong Kong to transform
what was once barren rock
into one of the most thriving
and successful places in Asia.
Aside from its harbor,

cues.zh: 香港唯一重要的另一项资源
cues.en: the only other important resource
of Hong Kong is people -
over 4½ million of them.
Like America a century ago,
Hong Kong in the past few decades
has been a haven for people
who sought the freedom to make the most
of their own abilities.
(traffic and marketplace sounds)

cues.zh: 他们中许多人是难民，来自那些
cues.en: Many of them are refugees from countries
that don't allow the economic
and political freedom

cues.zh: 而这些自由在香港被视为理所当然。
cues.en: that is taken for granted in Hong Kong.
Despite rapid population growth,
despite the lack of natural resources,
the standard of living

cues.zh: 仍是全亚洲最高的之一。
cues.en: is one of the highest in all of Asia.
(sewing machine & factory noises)
People work hard,
but Hong Kong's success

cues.zh: 并非建立在剥削工人之上。
cues.en: is not based on the exploitation of workers.
Wages in Hong Kong have gone up
four-fold since the War,

cues.zh: 这还是扣除通货膨胀后的数字。
cues.en: and that's after allowing for inflation.
The workers are free;

cues.zh: 可以自由选择工作时间，
cues.en: free to work what hours they choose,

cues.zh: 愿意的话也可以自由换工作。
cues.en: free to move to other jobs if they wish.

cues.zh: 市场给了他们这个选择。
cues.en: The market gives them that choice.

cues.zh: 市场也决定了他们生产什么。
cues.en: It also determines what they make.

cues.zh: 你可以确信，某个地方的某个人
cues.en: You can be sure that somebody somewhere
is willing to pay for these cheap,
plastic toys.

cues.zh: 否则它们根本就不会被生产。
cues.en: Otherwise they simply wouldn't be made.
Competition from places like
South Korea and Taiwan

cues.zh: 让廉价产品的利润变薄，
cues.en: has made cheap products less profitable,
so Hong Kong businessmen
have been adapting.
They have been developing
more sophisticated products
and new technology that can match

cues.zh: 西方或东方的任何水平，
cues.en: anything in the West or East,

cues.zh: 而他们的员工也一直在
cues.en: and their employees have been
developing new skills.
(high-tech machinery sounds)
Hong Kong never stops.
There's always some business to be done,
some opportunity to be seized.

cues.zh: 这里长期以来都是旅游中心
cues.en: It’s long been a tourist center
and a shopper’s paradise,

cues.zh: 如今它已成为商业中心之一
cues.en: and it's now one of the business centers
of the East.
It's the ordinary people of Hong Kong
who benefit from all this
effort and enterprise.
(bustling street sounds)

cues.zh: 这座繁荣、喧闹、充满活力的城市
cues.en: This thriving, bustling, dynamic city

cues.zh: 之所以成为可能，靠的是自由市场——
cues.en: has been made possible by the free market-

cues.zh: 事实上，是世界上最自由的市场。
cues.en: indeed, the freest market in the world.
The free market enables people

cues.zh: 可以进入任何想做的行业，
cues.en: to go into any industry they want,

cues.zh: 与任何想合作的人做生意，
cues.en: to trade with whomever they want,
to buy in the cheapest market
around the world,
to sell in the dearest market
around the world.
But most important of all,

cues.zh: 如果失败，他们自己承担代价。
cues.en: if they fail, they bear the cost.

cues.zh: 如果成功，他们获得收益。
cues.en: If they succeed, they get the benefit.
And it's that atmosphere of incentive
that has induced them to work,

cues.zh: 去适应、去储蓄，创造出奇迹。
cues.en: to adjust, to save, to produce a miracle.
This miracle hasn't been achieved
by government action,
by someone sitting in one
of those tall buildings
telling people what to do.
It's been achieved by allowing
the market to work.

cues.zh: 走在香港的任何一条街上
cues.en: Walk down any street in Hong Kong

cues.zh: 你都会看到那些 impersonal 的市场力量
cues.en: and you will see the impersonal forces
of the market in operation.
Mr. Cheung makes metal containers.
Nobody has ordered him to.

cues.zh: 他这样做是因为他发现
cues.en: He does it because he has found
that he can do better for himself that way

cues.zh: 胜过制作其他任何东西。
cues.en: than by making anything else.

cues.zh: 但如果对金属容器的需求
cues.en: But if demand for metal containers
went down,
or somebody found a way
of making them cheaper,

cues.zh: 张先生很快就会收到这个讯息。
cues.en: Mr. Cheung would soon get that message.
A few doors away,

cues.zh: 余先生的公司制作传统
cues.en: Mr. Yu's firm has been making traditional
Cantonese wedding gowns for 42 years.
But the demand

cues.zh: 华丽礼服的需求正在下降。
cues.en: for these elaborate garments is falling.

cues.zh: 这家公司已经收到了这个信号
cues.en: The firm has already gotten that message

cues.zh: 现在正寻找另一种产品。
cues.en: and is now looking for another product.
The market tells producers
not only what to produce,
but how best to produce it,
through another set of prices:
the cost of materials,
the wages of labor, and so on.
For example,

cues.zh: 如果这些工人做别的事
cues.en: if these workers could earn more
doing something else,

cues.zh: 何先生很快就会想办法
cues.en: Mr. Ho would soon find a way
to mechanize his picture frame production.
Inside this Chinese medicine shop,

cues.zh: 一桩市场交易正在进行。
cues.en: a market transaction is going on.
The customer's confidence
that this painful-looking ordeal

cues.zh: 对他有帮助，这份信心并不来自
cues.en: will help him doesn't rest
on any official certification
of the bone doctor's qualifications.
It comes from experience,

cues.zh: 他自己的或朋友的经验。
cues.en: his own or his friends’.
In his turn,

cues.zh: 他给病人治疗不是因为
cues.en: the doctor treats him not because
he has been ordered to,

cues.zh: 而是因为他能拿到报酬。
cues.en: but because he gets paid.
The transaction is voluntary,

cues.zh: 所以双方都必须预期能获益，
cues.en: so both parties must expect to benefit
or it will not take place.
Believe it or not, this backyard
is the entrance to a factory.
(factory noise)
The workers here are some of the
best paid in Hong Kong.

cues.zh: 这里又热又潮，而且极其吵闹。
cues.en: It's hot, sticky, and extremely noisy.
The workers are highly skilled,
so they can command high wages.

cues.zh: 他们本可以通过提出愿意
cues.en: They could induce their employer to improve

cues.zh: 接受更低工资来促使雇主
cues.en: working conditions by offering to work for

cues.zh: 改善工作条件，但他们宁愿接受
cues.en: less, but they would rather accept the
conditions, take the high wages,

cues.zh: 然后按自己的意愿花掉。
cues.en: and spend them as they wish.
That's their choice.

cues.zh: 对自由市场原则最著名的阐述，
cues.en: The best-known statement of the principles

cues.zh: 也就是香港所运行的那种
cues.en: of a free market, the kind of free market
that operates in Hong Kong,

cues.zh: 是在世界的另一端写下的。
cues.en: was written on the other side of the world.
(river running)
(bagpipes playing)
Two-hundred years ago, in Scotland,
Adam Smith taught at
the University of Glasgow.

cues.zh: 他那本杰出的著作《国富论》，
cues.en: His brilliant book, The Wealth of Nations,

cues.zh: 正是基于他在这里所做的演讲。
cues.en: was based on the lectures he gave here.
(birds singing)

cues.zh: 自由市场所依据的基本原则，
cues.en: The basic principles underlying the

cues.zh: 正如亚当·斯密在这所大学里
cues.en: free market, as Adam Smith taught
them to his students in this university,
are really very simple.
Look at this lead pencil.

cues.zh: 世界上没有任何一个人
cues.en: There is not a single person in the world
who could make this pencil.

cues.zh: 这话很惊人吗？一点也不。
cues.en: Remarkable statement? Not at all.
The wood from which it's made,
for all I know, comes from a tree that

cues.zh: 在华盛顿州被砍倒的树。
cues.en: was cut down in the State of Washington.

cues.zh: 砍倒那棵树，需要一把锯子。
cues.en: To cut down that tree, it took a saw.
To make the saw, it took steel.
To make the steel, it took iron ore.

cues.zh: 这个黑色的芯，我们叫它铅，但其实
cues.en: This black center, we call it lead but it's
really graphite, compressed graphite,
I'm not sure

cues.zh: 它来自哪里，但我想它来自
cues.en: where it comes from, but I think it comes
from some mines in South America.

cues.zh: 上面这个红色的橡皮头，
cues.en: This red top up here, the eraser,

cues.zh: 一小块橡胶，可能来自马来亚，
cues.en: a bit of rubber, probably comes from Malaya,

cues.zh: 而橡胶树在那里甚至都不是原生的。
cues.en: where the rubber tree isn't even native.
It was imported from South America
by some businessmen with the

cues.zh: 在英国政府的帮助下引进。
cues.en: help of the British government.

Never would deny that.
But we stand on the shoulders of
the people that went before us.

cues.zh: 我们必须看看他们从起点
cues.en: We have to look at how much they achieved

cues.zh: 走了多远，而那个时期正是
cues.en: from where they started, and that was

cues.zh: 大量移民从海外涌入的
cues.en: the period in which you had the tremendous
influx of immigrants from abroad,

cues.zh: 数以百万、百万、百万计的人，
cues.en: millions and millions and millions of them,

cues.zh: 那时你们开辟了一片新大陆，
cues.en: when you opened up a new continent,
when you had achievements.
Milton, are you saying, though,
that there's any sense, in which you'd rather
go back to those circumstances where
there are no regulations of factory work,

cues.zh: 没有工时、没有工时限制？
cues.en: no hours, limitations of hours worked?
Do you want to return to that
or do you just say that was a
stepping-stone to where we are now?
It depends on what you mean
by circumstances.
I don't want to have to go back to using a
horse and buggy instead of an automobile,
but I would prefer to go back to the
kinds of governmental regulations,

cues.zh: 或者说没有监管的状态，
cues.en: or absence of regulations,

cues.zh: 那时候个人享有更大的自由，
cues.en: the greater degree of freedom which was
given to individuals to pursue one activity
or another, which prevailed then,

cues.zh: 那种自由比现在更普遍。
cues.en: than which prevails now.
I think that, really,

cues.zh: 我们的工业领袖们是被
cues.en: our industrial leaders have been
dragged into the future screaming.
They resisted the Child Labor laws;

cues.zh: 他们抵制过社会保障、工会，
cues.en: they resisted Social Security, labor unions,
and now the environmental movement.
Once the government forced them to pay

cues.zh: 民众在选票箱和投票站的
cues.en: attention to those, by the voting of the
people in the ballot box and in the polling

cues.zh: 重视这些事，那么工业领袖、
cues.en: place, then the industrial leaders,

cues.zh: 商界领袖就开始重视这些
cues.en: business leaders, paid attention to those

cues.zh: 规则，而且在大多数情况下
cues.en: rules and have done a good job in
most cases of abiding by them.
FRIEDMAN: Excuse me.
Now Bob Galvin is an industrialist,
now come on, is that a fair statement?
Maybe the industrialists have a clearer
view of history and its prospects.
The most precious asset we possess is

cues.zh: 自由。失去自由最容易的方式
cues.en: freedom. The easiest way to lose one's
freedom is to go into receivership,

cues.zh: 我指的是经济上的破产管理。
cues.en: and I mean economic receivership.

cues.zh: 因为接管人就是独裁者。
cues.en: Because a receiver is a dictator.
And to the degree that we employ
the costs and the burdens of government
that lead us in the direction of further debt,
ultimate receivership,
and then the political consequence of the
imposition of the political dictator over

cues.zh: 个人的经济、工作和生活
cues.en: the economic and the job and the living
rights of the individual, maybe the
industrialists can see farther down the pike
as to the consequence of all this.
Michael Harrington.
I just think that -- two things.
One, to view freedom positively:

cues.zh: 我认为如今美国65岁以上的人
cues.en: I think people over 65 years of age
in the United States today are freer
now because of Medicare.

cues.zh: 我不认为因缺医少药而死去的自由
cues.en: I do not think that the freedom to die from
the lack of medicine was a very good thing.
Secondly, related to industrialists,

cues.zh: 我认为美国历史上一个令人惊讶之处是：
cues.en: I think that one of the startling things about
American history is that when Franklin

cues.zh: Roosevelt在从自身手中拯救这个制度时，
cues.en: Roosevelt was saving the system from itself,

cues.zh: 主要受益者们尖声怒骂
cues.en: the main beneficiaries were screaming

cues.zh: 骂他是叛徒，背叛了自己的阶级，
cues.en: bloody murder at him for being a traitor
to his class, when he was in fact
the salvation of that class.
And I think if you, therefore,

cues.zh: 如果你回顾我们的历史，
cues.en: if you look at our history,

cues.zh: 我确实认为你会发现实业家们
cues.en: I do think you find a tremendous myopia on

cues.zh: 有着极大的短视，而且你会发现
cues.en: the part of industrialists, and you find that
the positive increments to our freedom,
interestingly enough, have not come from

cues.zh: 大学毕业生，而往往来自
cues.en: the college graduates, but often from

cues.zh: 那些——并非来自最优秀的人。
cues.en: people with -- not from the best people.
It's come from working people,
it's come from poor people, it's come from
blacks and Hispanics and the like.
Milton, would you reply,

cues.zh: 但请告诉我们，你为什么带我们去
cues.en: but then tell us why you took us to
Hong Kong to prove something.
Sure.
Unaccustomed as I am to agreeing with

cues.zh: 迈克尔·哈林顿，但我部分同意
cues.en: Michael Harrington, I will agree in part
with what he's just said. I do not believe

cues.zh: 把情况说成是工业家对政府
cues.en: it's proper to put the situation in terms
of industrialist versus government.

cues.zh: 相反，我支持减少政府干预的原因之一
cues.en: On the contrary, one of the reasons why
I am in favor of less government is:

cues.zh: 因为当政府权力更大时
cues.en: because when you have more government

cues.zh: 工业家就会接管它，两者
cues.en: industrialists take it over, and the two

cues.zh: 联合起来形成联盟，对抗
cues.en: together form a coalition against the

cues.zh: 普通工人和普通消费者。
cues.en: ordinary worker and the ordinary consumer.

cues.zh: 我认为企业是一个了不起的制度，
cues.en: I think business is a wonderful institution
provided it has to face competition in

cues.zh: 市场上面对竞争，不能靠别的
cues.en: the marketplace and it can't get away

cues.zh: 蒙混过关，只能通过以更低成本
cues.en: with something except by producing a
better product at a lower cost,

cues.zh: 这就是为什么我不希望政府
cues.en: and that's why I don't want government to
step in and help the business community.
Now I want to go to your

cues.zh: 关于联邦医疗保险的问题。
cues.en: question about Medicare.
There are many people who have

cues.zh: 从联邦医疗保险中受益，
cues.en: benefited from Medicare,

cues.zh: 但你没有看成本这一面。
cues.en: but you're not looking at the cost side.
What has happened to the people who are

cues.zh: 经历了什么？这不是——我们没有免费
cues.en: paying for it? It isn't -- we don't have a free

cues.zh: 的福利，它不是凭空而来的。
cues.en: good, it isn't coming from nowhere.

cues.zh: 他们是否以具有成本效益的方式
cues.en: And are they benefiting from it in a cost

cues.zh: 从中受益？这些才是问题所在。
cues.en: effective way? Those are the questions.

cues.zh: 这是煽动人心，请原谅我这么说
cues.en: It's demagoguery, if you'll pardon
me, Michael Harrington, to say the people

cues.zh: 享有医疗保险的人更自由。
cues.en: who have Medicare are freer.

cues.zh: 当然，是从一个维度来说。
cues.en: Of course, in one dimension.

cues.zh: 但他们自己一辈子都在缴费，
cues.en: But they themselves have been paying all
their lives, and have they gotten a good
bargain? At the moment they have.
The young men, the young working people

cues.zh: 正在缴纳社会保障金的年轻劳动者，
cues.en: who are going into Social Security now,

cues.zh: 他们将来得到的待遇会非常不公平。
cues.en: they're going to get a very raw deal indeed.

cues.zh: 米尔顿，有意思的是，在这一点上，
cues.en: Milton, interestingly on that point,

cues.zh: 65岁以上的人现在支付的医疗费用
cues.en: people over 65 are paying more of their

cues.zh: 占其可支配收入的比例更高了，
cues.en: spendable income for medical care now,
than they were before Medicare was enacted.
It's been not a very successful program.
Government doesn't do things well.
It doesn't do things well if it hasn't
done things well in Britain, in Canada,
in the United States.

cues.zh: 米尔顿，接着你带我们去了香港，
cues.en: Now, Milton, then you took us to Hong Kong

cues.zh: 正是为了说明这一点。你说那里
cues.en: on exactly that point. That here you said

cues.zh: 是市场运作的真实典范。
cues.en: was a true model of the market operating.

cues.zh: 那么，这真的是对香港的
cues.en: Now is that really the fair
description of Hong Kong?

cues.zh: 目前来说，是的。这并不是——再说一次，
cues.en: At the moment, yes. It's not -- again,
there aren't any such things as a hundred
percent one way and a hundred percent

cues.zh: 偏向另一边的事。当然，一切都是混合的。
cues.en: the other. Everything is mixed, of course.
Hong Kong has a government, and it

cues.zh: 在这个例子里恰好是这样一个政府——
cues.en: happens to be a government in this case --
there's no democracy in Hong Kong.

cues.zh: 它由英国管辖。它是英国的
cues.en: It's run from Britain. It's a Crown Colony of

cues.zh: 一个直辖殖民地，由英国总督
cues.en: Britain, and the British governor general
and so on, and financial secretary run it.
But the situation in Hong Kong is:
That there is very little
government regulation of industry.
There's complete free trade.
There are no tariffs,
there are no export subsidies,
there are no restrictions on
the purchase and sale of monies,
so that it is,
comes about as close to
a complete free market
as you can find in the world today.
And there is no doubt
that the main beneficiaries
have been the low-income people,
the poor people who have poured
into Hong Kong by the hundreds
of thousands and millions,

cues.zh: 而且还有源源不断的人
cues.en: out of Red China and who keep on trying
to get in there.

cues.zh: 这就回到迈克尔·哈林顿的问题，
cues.en: This goes to Michael Harrington's question,
if an industrial system,

cues.zh: 如果一个自由企业制度
cues.en: if a free enterprise system
is a system in which the poor are ground
beneath the heels
of the rapacious industrialists
he's worried about,
how would he explain the success
in Hong Kong,

cues.zh: 如何解释人们不断用脚投票
cues.en: the extent to which people continue to vote
with their feet to go there?
You're not asking us to make
of the United States one gigantic
Hong Kong, or a sweatshop,

cues.zh: 或者随便你怎么称呼它。
cues.en: or whatever you want to call it.
You would acknowledge that there is
a historical development of an economy,

cues.zh: 对经济发展的某个阶段
cues.en: and what may be right for one stage
in the development of an economy

cues.zh: 对另一个阶段未必合适。
cues.en: may not be right for another stage.

cues.zh: 问题难道不是：我们接下来往哪走？
cues.en: Isn't the issue, where do we go from here?

cues.zh: 我们要做出哪些务实的决定，
cues.en: What pragmatic decisions do we make
about the direction
of the American economy?
Should it be toward
more and more government,
or should it be trying to preserve
an adequate balance between
freedom of choice
and government intervention?
Again, the problem is
to distinguish two things.

cues.zh: 这又回到之前的一个评论。
cues.en: This comes back to an earlier comment.
The circumstances in terms of
the physical arrangements,
and the circumstances in terms of the rules
that guide the society.
Now in the case of Hong Kong,

cues.zh: 当然，我不是要求我们把
cues.en: of course I'm not asking that we crowd
our people to a density of population
such as Hong Kong has.
Hong Kong is a marvelous example
just because its circumstances
are so terrible,
it's physical circumstances.
And the people in Hong Kong would love
to get elsewhere,
into less crowded circumstances,

cues.zh: 如果别人愿意让他们进来的话。
cues.en: if other people would let them in.
This is the problem of immigration,
which is a very important restriction
on human freedom.

cues.zh: 在1913年之前，我们拥有完全的、
cues.en: In the period before 1913 we had complete,
a hundred percent freedom of immigration
into the United States.

cues.zh: 现在没有了，但回到你的问题。
cues.en: We don't now, but go back to your question.

cues.zh: 你觉得香港还能存在吗，
cues.en: Do you think Hong Kong would exist
if it weren't in close juxtaposition
to Communist China?
Hong Kong would exist.
It is very dubious that it would have
the policies it has now if it weren't
in close juxtaposition
to Communist China.
Well, now, but to answer
your question directly:
Yes, I am in favor of the United States
having not the circumstances,
not the physical circumstances,
but the policies that Hong Kong

cues.zh: 所拥有的政策，即零关税、
cues.en: has had of zero tariffs,
of complete free trade,
of no restrictions on exports,
no restrictions on monetary transactions,

cues.zh: 政府监管程度要小得多……
cues.en: of a far greater degree of...far
lesser degree of governmental regulation.
I agree with what Russell Peterson
said before,
that there are third-party effects.
There are things like pollution.
The question is whether we're handling them

cues.zh: 以正确的方式处理它们，
cues.en: in the right way,
and I think we're not.
I want to bring Bob Galvin in here.
Bob, the beginning of Milton's agenda there,
no tariffs, for example,
no restrictions, no quotas.
Now, will business, big business,
wear that kind of policy?

cues.zh: 我认为大企业和所有企业
cues.en: I think big business and all business
could wear that kind of policy

cues.zh: 前提是我们能在其余世界贸易中找到
cues.en: if we could find the appropriate balancing
factor that in the rest of world trade,
where we trade outside our border,

cues.zh: 当别人进入我们的市场，
cues.en: and as others come in,
we are required to trade against
socialized institutions.

cues.zh: 那是一种非常不同的制度
cues.en: That's a very different kind of an institution
than the private institution.

cues.zh: 私营机构显然可以运作
cues.en: The private institution can clearly operate
more efficiently if it is not imposed upon
by an artificial price
from the socialized institution
across the seas.
So I think there has to be,
not protectionism,
but there has to be an international rule
of the road that prevents
the socialized institution
from subsidizing and taking advantage
of the private institution.

cues.zh: 你们是否把这九个国家
cues.en: Do you include the nine countries
to the Common Market,

cues.zh: 尽管它们是社会主义国家，
cues.en: though, as socialist countries,

cues.zh: 还是说你们准备开放竞争，
cues.en: or are you prepared to open competition
from all the nine countries
in the Common Market?
The nine countries
of the European Common Market
engage in the most dramatic
of the socialized institutions.

cues.zh: 我完全不同意他的观点。
cues.en: I don't agree with him at all.

cues.zh: 我们限制来自国外的贸易，
cues.en: We are hurting ourselves
by restricting trade from abroad.
Other countries are hurting

cues.zh: 它们自己和我们的利益，
cues.en: themselves and us

cues.zh: 就是通过你描述的那些措施，
cues.en: by the measures you describe,
but we're only hurting ourselves

cues.zh: 只会更严重地伤害自己。
cues.en: even the more if we imitate them.

cues.zh: 弗里德曼博士，我不认为
cues.en: I don't think, Dr. Friedman,
that your mother would get a job
sewing today in America

cues.zh: 如果我们完全没有关税的话。
cues.en: if we had no tariffs at all.
What would happen is:
there wouldn't be any sewing jobs
in America,
we'd be making nothing but computers.
But then there would be
some other kinds of jobs.

cues.zh: 然后她会找到一份工作
cues.en: Then she would get a job

cues.zh: 在制造计算机的非常低级的层面。
cues.en: at a very low level in making computers.

cues.zh: 是的。尽管你面临一个问题
cues.en: Yeah. Although you face the problem

cues.zh: 那就是你既有领先的商人
cues.en: that you've had both a leading businessman

cues.zh: 又有领先的保守派国会议员，
cues.en: and a leading conservative congressman,
not accepting your prescription
of sweeping away-

cues.zh: 但当然，两个最大的敌人——
cues.en: But, of course, the two greatest enemies --
I would say the greatest enemies
of free enterprise and of freedom
in the world
have been on the one hand the
industrialists, and on the other hand
most of my academic colleagues,
who end up in government.
For opposite reasons.
For opposite reasons.
Michael Harrington, I guess,
would agree with this.
People like Michael Harrington
and my academic colleagues

cues.zh: 想要为他们自己争取自由。
cues.en: want freedom for themselves.
They want free speech,
they want freedom to write,
they want freedom to publish,
to do research,
but they don't want freedom
for any of those awful businessmen.

cues.zh: 现在这些商人可大不一样了。
cues.en: Now the businessmen are very different.
Every businessman wants freedom
for somebody else,
but he wants special privilege for himself.

cues.zh: 他想让国会给关税保护，
cues.en: He wants a tariff from congress,
and the congressmen --
well the way in which congressmen
get elected is by performing favors
to constituents.
And if indeed you were to wipe out
completely all tariffs,

cues.zh: 就算你把这个国家的政府管制
cues.en: if you were to reduce government controls
in this country to what they are now,
I do not think that would be
in the self-interest of --
Well, then -
-- even Barber Conable,
for whom I have the very greatest respect,
or Bob Galvin,
for whom I have the respect.
I think it would be in the self-interest
of Michael Harrington.

cues.zh: 现在我们来问问美国人民
cues.en: Now let's ask what the American people
want and will wear,
because you're saying, in effect,
that to get elected
the congressman is giving the people
what they want.

cues.zh: 那么，你最终是不是在说，
cues.en: Now, aren't you saying in the end, then,
the people don't want this
or don't understand the advantage of it?
I'm saying that my whole function

cues.zh: 和目的就是试图说服人们
cues.en: and purpose is to try to persuade the people
to make a different thing
politically profitable.
I'm trying to persuade the people
to make it clear that congressmen

cues.zh: 推行这些政策的国会议员
cues.en: who pursue these policies
are gonna lose their jobs.
And if we do that,
congressmen are pursuing
their self-interests.
They're in a market,
there's a political market.

cues.zh: 他们有产品要卖，而且他们
cues.en: They've got a product to sell, and they've
got to appeal to their customers.
And I am just engaging
in the kind of advertising Mr. Galvin

cues.zh: 和其他公司所用的那种广告。
cues.en: and other companies use.
...very experienced politician,
Governor Peterson.
Well, let me ask you how

cues.zh: 你会如何应对这个问题，
cues.en: you would cope with this problem,
Dr. Friedman.

cues.zh: 人们决定他们想要凉爽的空气，
cues.en: The people decided that they wanted cool air,
and there was tremendous need,

cues.zh: 于是我们建立了一个庞大的产业，
cues.en: and so we built a huge industry,
the air conditioning industry,
hundreds of thousands of jobs,
tremendous earnings opportunities

cues.zh: 现在我们几乎所有人都有空调
cues.en: and nearly all of us now have air conditioned
homes and cars and offices.
Then the people decided
they wanted clean air,
and they couldn't buy it in the marketplace,

cues.zh: 于是他们在投票站投票。
cues.en: so they voted at the polling place.
They got elected representatives
to go to the congress and say,
we are going to have clean air.

cues.zh: 一夜之间就有了一个新市场，
cues.en: Now overnight there was a new market,
and the free enterprise system
responded to that, and now

cues.zh: 有一个庞大的环保产业
cues.en: there's a big environmental industry
making earnings,
providing jobs,

cues.zh: 同时也服务于这一公共需求
cues.en: but also serving this public need

cues.zh: 即拥有呼吸清洁空气的自由。
cues.en: to have the freedom to breathe clean air.
You grossly underestimate the extent

cues.zh: 私人市场能做到这件事的程度。
cues.en: to which the private market is able to do it.
It's not an accident that the air,

cues.zh: 在你们有任何这些立法之前，
cues.en: before you had any of this legislation,
air and water were cleaner
in the United States today
than they were in the United States
a hundred years ago.
You know the automobile added
one kind of pollution,

cues.zh: 但它消除了严重得多的
cues.en: but it eliminated a far worse
kind of pollution.

cues.zh: 如果你想想纽约的街道
cues.en: If you consider what the streets of New York
would look like today

cues.zh: 如果你们还在运送人们
cues.en: if you were still transporting people
by horse-drawn vehicles,
you would have pollution on a scale
that would stagger you.
In the same way,

cues.zh: 这不是偶然的，空气更干净
cues.en: it's not an accident that the air is cleaner
and the water purer in those countries today
that are the most advanced,

cues.zh: 比它们在落后国家更干净。
cues.en: than they are in the backwards country.
It's not been in Afghanistan

cues.zh: 你找不到干净的空气和水。
cues.en: that you find clean air and water.
It's in the advanced countries.
So the market is a very much more
subtle mechanism than people
give it credit for being.
I would like to get this back to the

cues.zh: 现实世界，因为在现实世界中
cues.en: real world, because in the real world
there is no possibility
that American business,
which is a welfare-dependent
business system,
is going to adopt these ideas.

cues.zh: 这些理念在现实世界中的作用
cues.en: What these ideas function as

cues.zh: 不过是给这个神话找的合理化借口
cues.en: in the real world
is a rationalization for the myth
of free enterprise,
which disguises the fact

cues.zh: 把国家资本主义当作论据
cues.en: of state capitalism as an argument
against social intervention,

cues.zh: 在一个确实会干预的社会里
cues.en: in a society that does intervene

cues.zh: 很快代表钢铁行业发声。
cues.en: on behalf of the steel industry very quickly.
Finally in terms of
the American political process,
I don't believe that the political process
is so simple as having the people
elect the government.
The fact is:
that when a Jimmy Carter
is elected president
on a relatively liberal platform,

cues.zh: 他必须赢得商界的信心，
cues.en: he then has to win business confidence,
because of the control
of the investment process
by corporate power.
And I think that fact,
corporate power,

cues.zh: 被自由企业神话所合理化，
cues.en: rationalized by free enterprise myths,
is the central problem of freedom
in our time,

cues.zh: 而这正是必须被抨击的。
cues.en: and that's what has to be attacked.

cues.zh: 在我们再次请米尔顿发言之前——
cues.en: Before we come to Milton again -
No, no.
I've got to comment on this,

cues.zh: 因为我认为我们不能让言辞
cues.en: because I think we mustn't let words
get in the way of what really is the case.

cues.zh: 我理解你认为我们没有社会主义。
cues.en: I take it you think we don't have socialism.
I would say to you that 46 percent
of every corporation in this country
is owned by the U.S. Government.
That's the corporate income tax,

cues.zh: 这意味着企业每赚一美元
cues.en: that means out of every dollar
of profits the corporation makes,
46 cents goes to the U.S. Government.
The actual tax is far higher than that
because you tax that doubly
when it comes to the individual.

cues.zh: 企业对自身投资决策的
cues.en: The extent to which corporations control
their investment decisions
has been increasingly reduced.
The government is dictating what they

cues.zh: 把投资资金花在什么地方
cues.en: spend their investment funds on
in the name of pollution control,
in the name of other things.
It's a myth to suppose
that there is some kind of
a big corporate power over here.
There was a time when corporations
were more influential than they are now,
but at the moment I think they're
a beleaguered minority
rather than the dominant majority.
I'd like to take the others
into this for a moment.
What is the process,
for those of you who want to
roll back the state,

cues.zh: 或想要遏制政府影响力
cues.en: or to push back governmental influence,

cues.zh: 对经济运行的作用的人来说？
cues.en: on the operation of the economy?

cues.zh: 在我们让米尔顿参与之前，
cues.en: Before we let Milton in on that,
what would you do as an active politician,

cues.zh: 作为另一位政治家和商人，你会怎么做？
cues.en: as another politician, and a businessman?

cues.zh: 嗯，我个人认为我们应该限制
cues.en: Well, I personally think we ought to restrain
the growth of government in the future.
How?
By putting some sort of limit
on government expenditures.
I would like to see

cues.zh: 通过宪法修正案来实现这一点，
cues.en: a constitutional amendment doing that,
otherwise we're going to continue

cues.zh: 让政府增长得比经济更快，
cues.en: to have the government growing faster
than the economy and thus pushing more
and more of the gross national product

cues.zh: 通过政府这个漏斗消耗掉。
cues.en: through the tin horn of government.
I think that would be a mistake.
It's a difficult thing to do.

cues.zh: 我希望我们能找到某种办法
cues.en: I hope we can find some way
to do it without making ourselves

cues.zh: 削弱我们自由的前提下做到。
cues.en: less free in some way.

cues.zh: 彼得森州长，这能做到吗？
cues.en: Governor Peterson, can it be done?
Yes, I think we can make

cues.zh: 取得实质性进展，通过推进
cues.en: substantial headway by furthering
our pluralistic society,
by encouraging,
educating more people
to think comprehensively.

cues.zh: 我觉得我们这个世界的一大问题
cues.en: I think one of the big problems in our world
is that leaders in government

cues.zh: 和企业界的领导者目光短浅。
cues.en: and in industry are shortsighted.

cues.zh: 他们不考虑自己决策的
cues.en: They don't look at the long-term impacts
of their decisions.

cues.zh: 而在我们这样的民主国家
cues.en: And in a democracy such as ours
the power is with the people,
just like the textbooks say.
And if they get this more
comprehensive understanding
and knowledge,
they're gonna see to it
that the special interests
of the elected officials

cues.zh: 会与争取连任保持一致，
cues.en: will be in tune with getting reelected,
and they will look at the long-term views
just like the citizenry is.
So I am all in favor
of an all-out push
to get this freedom to vote
in the polling place,
added to the freedom of the marketplace,

cues.zh: 因为那是一种强大的组合。
cues.en: because that's a potent combination.
But voting in the polling place

cues.zh: 是一种非常不同的自由
cues.en: is a very different kind of freedom
than voting in the marketplace.
When you vote in the polling place,
it is important,
but it's very different.

cues.zh: 投票时，你是在为一个整体方案投票。
cues.en: When you vote, you vote for a package.

cues.zh: 而且，如果你属于少数派，你就输了。
cues.en: And, if you are in the minority, you lose.
you don't get what you want.
When you vote in the marketplace

cues.zh: 每个人都能得到自己投票选择的东西。
cues.en: everybody gets what he votes for.
If you vote for a --

cues.zh: 我投票选一条绿色领带，我就得到一条绿色领带。
cues.en: I vote for a green tie, I get a green tie.

cues.zh: 你投票选一条蓝色领带，你就得到一条蓝色领带。
cues.en: You vote for a blue tie, you get a blue tie.

cues.zh: 如果我们在投票站也这么做，
cues.en: If we do that in the polling booth,

cues.zh: 如果我们中60%的人投票选绿色领带，
cues.en: if 60 percent of us vote for a green tie,
you have to wear a green tie.

cues.zh: 哦，但那40%的人不会就此闭嘴。
cues.en: Oh, but the 40 percent don't just shut up.
They can try to influence

cues.zh: 决策以符合自己的意愿。
cues.en: decision-making to their own.

cues.zh: 当然他们可以试图影响，
cues.en: Of course they can try to influence
but it's a very different
and less efficient mechanism

cues.zh: 用来匹配表现、匹配结果，
cues.en: for matching performance, matching results,
to individual taste and preference.
Whatever kind of car I buy,

cues.zh: 我仍然呼吸着肮脏的空气。
cues.en: I still get dirty air.
There are good people running this society,

cues.zh: 而我们谈论的大多数人
cues.en: and most of the people
that we're talking about work someplace,
and they know that their company

cues.zh: 在做一些相当不错的事，
cues.en: is doing something pretty good,

cues.zh: 或者正努力做一些相当不错的事。
cues.en: or trying to do something pretty good.
I think the people are going to
start telling the leaders
where they've gone wrong
and start to redress it
by the direction of the ballot box.
The people in general are more conservative

cues.zh: 而在具体问题上更开明。
cues.en: and in particular are more liberal.
That is to say,
if you ask the people in general,
what do you think of government,
"Get it off my back, less taxes."
If you ask in particular what about health,
national health;
what about full employment,
government is the employer of last resort.
What about pollution, do something about it.

cues.zh: 大约一年前，Everett Ladd 在《财富》上
cues.en: Everett Ladd had an article
in Fortune about a year ago,

cues.zh: 那可不是什么激进的左翼刊物，
cues.en: which is hardly a radical left-wing journal,
showing this contradiction.
And I think that there is
in the United States today

cues.zh: 正有一股迅速向左转的趋势，
cues.en: a rapid movement to the left,
right and center, which I, obviously,
hope will be resolved
not by an across-the-boards cut

cues.zh: 主要面向穷人和工薪阶层，
cues.en: aimed primarily at poor and working people,

cues.zh: 而是通过日益民主化的
cues.en: but by an increasing democratization
of economic power,
and an increasing democratization
of the government.

cues.zh: 我认为在这个复杂的社会里
cues.en: I think that in this complicated society

cues.zh: 充斥着庞大的机构和官僚体系，
cues.en: of huge institutions and bureaucracies,
if we talk about freedom,

cues.zh: 我希望看到的其中一件事
cues.en: one of the things I would like to see

cues.zh: 就是制定一项法律，提供资金
cues.en: would be a law providing funds

cues.zh: 让任何重要的少数群体
cues.en: for any significant minority

cues.zh: 能够购买研究资源来对抗多数群体。
cues.en: to buy the research to counter the majority.
If you don't have the expertise,
the knowledge technology today,
you're out of the debate.
And I think that we have to
democratize information and government
as well as the economy and society.
I am sorry to say Michael Harrington's

cues.zh: 方案并不能解决这个问题。
cues.en: solution is not a solution to it.

cues.zh: 他想要少数人统治，我不想。
cues.en: He wants minority rule, I don't.
I want individual rule.
I want human beings separately
and individually
to have control of their lives.

cues.zh: 我不认为一个与我意见相左的少数群体
cues.en: I don't believe that a minority
that differs with me should have the right
to take money out of my pocket
to do research for them.
They should go out
and try to persuade people
to contribute to them.

cues.zh: 我应该有自由去让人们
cues.en: I should be free to get people

cues.zh: 为我捐款，来传播我的想法。
cues.en: to contribute to me to present my ideas.
But the idea of having some kind of
an official government agency
that is going to finance dissidents--
in the first place,
anybody who has any sense of realism
about the way government operates at all
will know that will end up
in the hands of the majority
and not the minority.
But can government
in this extremely interdependent,

cues.zh: 不断发展、复杂的全球经济中，
cues.en: complex world economy which is developing,

cues.zh: 能否抱有一种神秘信仰，
cues.en: can you have a mystical belief

cues.zh: 相信亚当·斯密的看不见的手？
cues.en: in the invisible hand of Adam Smith?
I happen to think that Adam Smith

cues.zh: 是最伟大的知识巨匠之一
cues.en: was one of the greatest intellectual figures
in the history of the world,
and that capitalism was one
of the greatest advances
that humankind has ever made.
But precisely because I put this

cues.zh: 放在历史背景中来看；资本主义，
cues.en: in historical context; capitalism,

cues.zh: 正如我一位名叫 Karl Marx 的朋友所说
cues.en: as a friend of mine by the name of Karl Marx

cues.zh: 一段时间以前就有人预测，
cues.en: predicted some time ago,

cues.zh: 已经发展出巨大的趋势
cues.en: has developed tremendous tendencies
towards monopoly, concentration,
multinational corporations,
money supplies that are not controlled

cues.zh: 不受联邦储备银行控制
cues.en: by the Federal Reserve Bank
or even the president
of the United States anymore.
And to think that you can respond
to this radically new environment

cues.zh: 来应对这个全新的环境，
cues.en: by an 18th century solution,
I think really comes down to

cues.zh: 一种智力练习，其实际的、
cues.en: an intellectual exercise whose practical,
political effect is to rationalize

cues.zh: 美国的保守派权力提供合理化依据。
cues.en: conservative power in America.

cues.zh: 这是一个迷思，一个彻头彻尾的迷思，
cues.en: This is a myth, a complete myth,
that the development
of an inter-developed country

cues.zh: 在一个更复杂的世界中
cues.en: in a more complicated world
necessitates greater
government intervention.
Government intervention has not grown
in those areas which arise out

cues.zh: 世界的复杂性和相互依存的
cues.en: of the complexity and interdependence
of the world.
It's grown where?

cues.zh: 在于从一些人那里拿钱
cues.en: In taking money from some people
and giving it to others.
All I have to say is that government,

cues.zh: 弗里德曼博士，必须活在20世纪，
cues.en: Dr. Friedman, has to live in the 20th century,
Of course.
-- much less the 19th or the 18th.
And we have to take society
as it exists today
and build on that.

cues.zh: 对我来说，这里的关键问题
cues.en: To me, the decisive thing at issue here

cues.zh: 本质上是一种神话式的、
cues.en: is an essentially mythic,
nonhistorical presentation
of an abstract solution,
taken out of time,

cues.zh: 它没有看到资本主义社会
cues.en: which does not look to the tremendous
evolution of capitalist society,
the tremendous interdependence
of the world,

cues.zh: 以及这样一个事实：我们现在不仅有
cues.en: the fact that we now have
not only national economic planning,

cues.zh: 而且在东京峰会上我们
cues.en: but at the Tokyo summit we have

cues.zh: 将主要工业资本主义强国的
cues.en: institutionalized international
economic planning
of the major industrial capitalist powers.
And under those circumstances,
granted the enormous achievement
of Adam Smith,
granted the enormous achievement
of the capitalist society,
under this radically changed
historical situation

cues.zh: 提出那些经典的老解决方案，
cues.en: to propose those classic old solutions,
I think is to propose something
nonserious which, however,

cues.zh: 它确实在严肃地发挥作用，为
cues.en: does function seriously to rationalize
conservative corporate economic

cues.zh: 和政治权力提供合理化依据。
cues.en: and political power.
The great achievements
of the 19th century came from --
by departing from the kind of system

cues.zh: 你现在想重新强加的那种制度。
cues.en: you now want to reimpose.
You want to take us back to
the 18th and 17th century
when we had a corporate society,

cues.zh: 那个政府掌控一切的时代。
cues.en: when we had government controlling things.
The whole issue is not
what somebody is proposing

cues.zh: 19世纪或18世纪提出了什么主张，
cues.en: in the 20th, or the 19th and the 18th,
the whole issue is
what is the right thing to do?
What is the best way
in which we can widen our opportunities,
preserve our freedom,
maintain our prosperity,

cues.zh: 而在我看来，你会提出的那类解决方案
cues.en: and it seems to me the kind of solutions
you would propose involve more of the same,

cues.zh: 重复那些已经失败的措施
cues.en: more of the measures that have failed
over and over again
to achieve the objectives.

cues.zh: 好了，本周的辩论就到这里
cues.en: Well, we leave the debate there this week

cues.zh: 希望你能再次加入我们
cues.en: and we hope you'll join us again
for the next edition of Free To Choose.
(closing music)
